review.decision: Eliminate historical case coupling in test_design PR history, narrow mobile CI scope, shard Android phone flows, remove duplicate menubar Release compiles, and pin workflow environments and action SHAs
review.notes: User-approved workflow review items 1, 2, 3.1-3.3, 4.1-4.3, and 5.1 (5.2 local git hooks intentionally excluded). Verify negative fail-closed boundaries alongside scope/sharding speedups.

cases.description: PR history gate preserves unchanged historical case mappings when an existing test file adds newly reviewed cases
cases.setup: Create an isolated Git repository with a baseline test file mapped to a sealed historical case, then add a second reviewed and sealed design case in an earlier PR commit before appending a new test and case ID to the existing file.
cases.action: Run test_design.history_errors across incremental case additions, same-commit design violations, and unresealed edits with no added case ID.
cases.expected: Appending a newly reviewed case ID to an existing test file passes without requiring the untouched historical plan to be re-sealed, while modifying an existing test file with neither a newly reviewed case nor a re-sealed existing case still fails closed.

cases.description: CI scope narrows mobile release metadata and non-shared RN UI changes while preserving Web shared-source and universal Mac checks
cases.setup: Evaluate ci.classify on mobile release-notes metadata, pure RN UI components, Web-shared mobileapp sources, and inspect ci.yml/ios-store-assets.yml/release.yml contracts.
cases.action: Run ci_test scope, Mac universal product, pinned host/toolchain, Node LTS uniformity, and SHA-pinned workflow action assertions.
cases.expected: Mobile release metadata (.srchash, android.json, GtmuxMobile.xcodeproj) selects mobile/iOS/Android gates without unrelated Go/menubar/Worker suites; non-shared RN UI files skip Web while Web-consumed mobileapp files still select Web; menubar verifies universal arm64+x86_64 binaries via build.sh without duplicate full Release builds; ios-store-assets pins macos-15 and Xcode 26.3; and workflows SHA-pin third-party actions.

cases.description: Android phone and tablet emulator suites both execute across two verified shards under their existing aggregate check names
cases.setup: Provide synthetic QA APK and shard 1/2 execution receipts and job histories for both phone and tablet profiles.
cases.action: Run android_ci_results shard selection, attempt resolution, lane verification, and device summary verification for both phone and tablet.
cases.expected: Both phone and tablet split the 31-case suite cleanly across shards 1 and 2 without crossing setup groups, preserve per-shard receipts across failed-only reruns, and publish the exact required aggregate check names Android phone emulator flows and Android tablet emulator flows.
